name: discord-mcp
description: Safe, configurable Discord access through the Model Context Protocol

settings.name: Discord Bot Token
settings.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Never use a user token.

settings.name: Allowed Discord server IDs
settings.description: Optional comma-separated guild IDs. Leave blank to use every guild visible to the bot.

settings.name: Allowed Discord channel IDs
settings.description: Optional comma-separated channel IDs. Leave blank to use every channel in an allowed guild.

settings.name: Enable message writes
settings.description: Set true to expose send and own-message edit tools. The default is false.

settings.name: Enable message deletes
settings.description: Set true to expose confirmed own-message deletes. Writes must also be enabled.

settings.name: Allow writes without an allowlist
settings.description: Set true only to deliberately permit writes in every visible guild channel.

settings.name: Maximum response characters
settings.description: Optional integer from 1000 to 200000. The default is 50000.
